newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SWIMMING-AUSTRALIA BREAK MEN'S 4X200 FREESTYLE RELAY RECORD.
newsitem.headline: SWIMMING-AUSTRALIA BREAK MEN'S 4X200 FREESTYLE RELAY RECORD.

text.p: Australia set a men's 4x200 metres freestyle relay world short-course record at the world short-course swimming championships on Friday.
Michael Klim, Grant Hackett, Bill Kirby and Matthew Dunn clocked seven minutes 02.74 seconds to win the final.
They beat the mark of 7:05.17 set on February 9, 1986, by a West German quartet of Rainer Henkel, Alexander Schwotka, Dirk Korthals and Michael Gross.
